description: Create the full Typst document (propuesta-smarttemp.typ) that reproduces the 6-page commercial proposal with parameterized variables, professional styling, and correct A4 layout.
steps: Create /projects/sandbox/Presupuesto/propuesta-smarttemp.typ with parameterized variables at the top for: client_name, date, quantity_sensors, quantity_interfaces, price_kit, price_interface, price_sensor, price_mobile, price_server_monthly, abono_5_30, abono_31_50, abono_50_plus, contact_email, contact_phone, contact_web

Implement Page 1 (Cover): centered layout with SmartTemp brand name (italic, #29b6f6), 'Calibration Systems' subtitle, 'Sistema de Monitoreo de Temperatura' description, cover subtitle text, and 5 badges (Cloud Propio, Alertas WhatsApp, Asistente IA, Calibracion Trazable, Dashboard Web). Include a thermometer icon/graphic element.

Implement Page 2 (El Sistema SmartTemp): header with brand, section title, intro paragraph, 6 feature cards in a 2-column grid with colored left borders (blue, green, orange, red, purple, green), plus the TERMO highlight box with gradient background (blue to green).

Implement Page 3 (Esquema + Datos Tecnicos): system flow diagram showing Sensores -> WiFi -> Cloud -> Alertas -> Usuario with circular icons and arrows, followed by a technical specs table with 12 rows (blue header, alternating row colors).

Implement Page 4 (Aplicaciones): 3x2 grid of application cards (Salud, Cadena de Frio, Farmaceutica, Alimentos, Laboratorios, Industria) with emoji icons, plus 'Funcionalidades Incluidas' section with 12 checkmark bullet items.

Implement Page 5 (Planes Comerciales): two plan boxes side-by-side (Plan A Pago Unico featured with blue border, Plan B Abono Mensual), pricing example table for Plan A (2 sensors, total USD 1400), pricing example table for Plan B (5 sensors, USD 500 initial + 300/mes), and commercial conditions box.
Implement Page 6 (Por que SmartTemp + Contacto): 6 advantage cards in 2-column grid, highlight box with savings message, and centered contact card with parameterized email/phone/web.
Add consistent page footer on all pages: 'SmartTemp - Monitoreo Inteligente de Temperatura' left-aligned, 'Pagina N' right-aligned.
Add page header (pages 2-6): brand name 'SmartTemp' with tagline separated by a blue bottom border.
Verify the document compiles cleanly with: typst compile propuesta-smarttemp.typ propuesta-smarttemp.pdf
acceptance_criteria: Running 'typst compile propuesta-smarttemp.typ propuesta-smarttemp.pdf' produces a PDF without errors
The .typ file has parameterized variables at the top that can be changed for different clients
The PDF has exactly 6 pages matching the structure of the HTML original
Brand color #29b6f6 is used consistently for headings, borders, and accents
Tables have proper formatting with colored headers and clean borders
Feature cards have colored left borders matching the HTML (blue, green, orange, red, purple)
The document uses sans-serif font styling
verification: typst compile propuesta-smarttemp.typ propuesta-smarttemp.pdf 2>&1 | grep -i error || echo 'No compilation errors'
findings: Compiled successfully with Typst 0.15.1. Font used: Noto Sans (DejaVu Sans not available as non-mono). Some emoji symbols (globe.meridians, light.police, signal, recycle) not available in Typst emoji module - used direct Unicode characters instead. Dollar signs must be escaped as \$ in content blocks to avoid math mode. Tight spacing required on page 5 to fit all pricing content within one page.
